clips.prompt: Continuing in one unbroken shot: ultra-macro darkness, a pool of perfectly still black water with a faint opalescent sheen spreading outward across the surface; a single glassy droplet hangs suspended above the water while one thin white beam of light crosses the darkness through it; the droplet sways gently, light trembling inside the glass; extreme slow, premium high-speed camera aesthetic, deep blacks. One single unbroken shot, no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

Continuing the same unbroken shot, the white beam passes through the hanging droplet and fans outward, becoming thin separated rays of cyan, violet, magenta and amber, the spectral fan slowly widening, colored reflections spreading across the still water; the droplet quivers, barely holding on; ultra-macro, slow. One single unbroken shot, no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

Continuing the same unbroken shot, the droplet meets the surface and a liquid-glass crown erupts upward in extreme slow motion: opalescent walls rising outward, every peak rim-lit with spectral fire, a center column climbing, tiny droplets thrown outward from the peaks; phantom high-speed camera look, soft bloom, deep blacks. One single unbroken shot, no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

Continuing the same unbroken shot, the crown reaches full height and sheds dozens of glass droplets that hang suspended around it, each droplet carrying one spectral color, thin light stretching outward from the peaks, the crown walls shimmering with opalescent sheen; extreme slow motion, macro. One single unbroken shot, no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.

Continuing the same unbroken shot, the crown settles and the droplets rejoin the surface as spectral rings ripple outward across the black water, color draining from the rings as they spread, the water returning to perfect stillness, one thin ring fading at the far edge, everything else deep ink darkness, minimal, silent, final. One single unbroken shot, no cuts, no text, no logos, no people.
